comparisons.peer_summary: The company receives significant revenue from a limited number of customers, with Customer A representing 13% and an indirect customer approximately 19% of total revenue in fiscal year 2024, both attributable to the Compute & Networking segment. Operating results depend on partner network sales, but customers can cancel or delay commitments with little notice, and partner purchasing patterns may change due to competition or internal developments.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA disclose that their customers can typically cancel, change, or delay purchase commitments with little notice and without penalty, reflecting a similar order-based sales model. However, NVIDIA further emphasizes that this flexibility exists within the context of significant customer and channel concentration, noting that operating results depend on a limited number of customers and partners, whereas Intel's disclosure focuses on the general nature of purchase order cancellations and the occasional use of additional non-standard agreements.
